serves: PH.1 (D1.1) Isolation Forest -- the dev-only scikit-learn rank-agreement oracle
why: The compact ten-project structural fixture cannot measure RANK agreement: nine of its ten points are a near-identical cluster, so the ordering WITHIN the cluster is ensemble sampling noise in both implementations and a rank correlation over it measures noise rather than agreement. This fixture is a seeded 300-project population with a GRADED radial spread -- radius 0.3 to 6.3 standard deviations, quadratic in the index -- so that true isolation differs materially between neighbouring ranks and order is a real property of the data rather than of the draw. Generator: random.Random(330001), three coordinates drawn standard normal and rescaled onto the target radius.
generator_rule: r_i = 0.3 + 6.0 * (i/299)^2; direction uniform on the unit sphere
